title: RAE KPI Snapshot
description: Build-time snapshot contract for homepage KPI strip. Static-export safe — no secrets, no runtime fetch.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only with migration notes in KPI_LIVE_SOURCE_PLAN.md.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when snapshot was produced or last refreshed.

source.description: Provenance of values. Never store credentials in this file.

status.description: verified = data-owner approved; pending-live-source = show placeholder notice in UI.

metrics.description: Exactly four homepage KPI cards in registry order.

value.description: Display value e.g. 120+, 85. Not a raw number — formatting is intentional.

highlight.description: Gold accent card. At most one metric per snapshot may be true.
